codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of four public resource loading methods on Application: load_texture (sRGB), load_texture_unorm (linear), load_mesh (GLTF/GLB), and load_animation (GLTF clip by name). All return AppResult<T> with descriptive error variants. Documentation on ApplicationBuilder explains the handle-based asset workflow. The implementation follows existing patterns, has no unwrap() calls in production code, uses proper error handling with AppError variants, and respects module visibility conventions (resource_loading is a private module, only the pub methods on Application are exposed).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The app-worker SKILL.md describes TDD procedure ('Write Tests First') but the worker correctly noted that GPU-required methods cannot be unit-tested. The skill doesn't acknowledge that not all features are testable via TDD — it should include guidance on when TDD is not applicable (e.g., methods requiring Vulkan renderer).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: SKILL.md section '3. Write Tests First (TDD)' mandates writing failing tests before implementation for every feature. Transcript shows worker ran cargo test (208 pass) but added no new tests, noting: 'The resource loading methods cannot be unit-tested without a Vulkan renderer (GPU required).'

sharedStateObservations.observation: The new resource_loading module with load_texture, load_mesh, load_animation public API on Application is a significant addition to the app's public surface but is not documented in .factory/library/architecture.md. Future workers would benefit from knowing these entry points exist.

summary: The feature is correctly implemented. All four resource loading methods match the feature description signatures. load_texture returns AppResult<TextureHandle> with sRGB format, load_texture_unorm provides linear color space variant (bonus beyond spec), load_mesh returns AppResult<MeshHandle> wrapping GLTF mesh loading with skinned/static mesh support, and load_animation returns AppResult<AnimationClip> with optional clip name filtering. Error handling is thorough with AppError::ModelLoadFailed for GLTF errors and AppError::Other with descriptive messages for image/animation errors. No unwrap() calls in production code. The module is properly scoped as a private module with only public methods exposed on Application. Documentation on ApplicationBuilder is clear and useful. No bugs or correctness issues found.
